# Gospel of Thomas, Saying 73 — The LOGOS Bible (Formal Equivalence)

**Source:** Nag Hammadi Codex II, p. 48 | Coptic

---

## Saying 73

Jesus said: "The harvest is plentiful, but the workers are few. Pray to the Lord to send workers into his harvest."

---

**Translator's Notes (LOGOS):**

- "Plentiful" — standard English rendering of *polus* (great/many/abundant)
- "Workers" over "laborers" — more natural English
- "His harvest" added for clarity of antecedent (the Lord's harvest)
